settings.name: decision-gate
settings.description: A typed decision inside an agent lane: the question, its probability, whose word it is, the band that follows, and the record that later calibrates the thresholds. Drawn from the two Jev reviews (b02ec47d, 80f50d5b) and a real lane on 2026-09-28.
settings.notes:
Draft 0, 2026-10-05, session miadi-jev (Opus 5.5) at William's request: study the two Jev reviews (b02ec47d "10 Levels of Jev", 80f50d5b "System-1 Decision Engineering") against Miadi and the live tmux lanes, grounded relationally (Wilson).

Why it exists. William: "LLMs are not type-safe outputs; that explains why the miadi-chronicle got messy" and "there really is something about decisions which basically we really need". The lanes most often get one question wrong: is this the owner's decision, or my reading of it? Seven moments observed; the scenario is the clearest (trading lane c9ee574b, 2026-09-28: "You asked whether your version made sense, and I took that as a decision and deployed it (#173)").

Three rules the drawing holds:
1. The relational gate comes first and is never computed. A decision with a named word-owner goes to that person whatever the probability (council-record.spec.md §3.2, medicine-wheel#155). Thresholds govern only the lane's own reversible decisions.
2. Unread is not a pass. read_status 'unknown' never acts (medicine-wheel infra preconditions.ts).
3. A person's words and an agent's reading of them are two fields (Ruling.words, Ruling.reading).

Open for William: which decider (Jev, a local classifier, a small model); the first act_at/block_at per question class; whether TandT models (llms-digital-decision-making.md) become the composite form, one Noul per element.

Where it would plug in first, in Miadi: the STC triage record (config/stc-steering.json:21 already asks for verdict, confidence, execute), the worker-stopped route (a stop is a fact; done is a judgement), the attention store (episodic-memory-schema attention.ts).

actors.name: William
actors.description: Holds the word on decisions that are his: live services, names, deletions, anything outward-facing.

actors.name: Lane
actors.description: An agent session in a tmux pane doing one piece of work (here the trading wave-labeler lane, session c9ee574b).

actors.name: Decider
actors.description: The System-1 decider: answers a typed question (Choice, Score, Noul) with a probability in under a second. Jev is one candidate; a local classifier or a small model is another. It never acts.

actors.name: Witness
actors.description: T3, Mino: carries a held question to William and his answer back, with author and time.

actors.name: Chronicle
actors.description: Where the decision record is kept: the episode vessel and the medicine wheel.
